description: Round18 expanded TS/JS reviewed-corpus work queue. It appends 40 light/medium fixed-commit public OSS subjects to the round17 12-subject corpus to dilute single-repository contribution in the next run. This is agent-reviewed only and not a public 99% precision claim.

selectionPolicy.source: Round17 12-subject reviewed corpus plus frontier-ranked subjects from the 200-repository production-scope candidate bundle.
constraints: no dependency install and no target package scripts
candidate sampled included findings between 2 and 12
candidate total included findings no more than 200
exclude repositories already present in the round17 corpus
add enough other-repository sampled findings to reduce the previous 25-finding max repository contribution below 10% in the next sampled run, assuming similar sampling behavior
selectionPolicy.manifestReview: New subjects are copied from production-scope inferred control manifests into docs and marked as single-agent reviewed for the next diagnostic run. They are not external-claim-ready until independent human/organization manifest review attestations bind each reviewedManifestSha256.
selectionPolicy.limitation: This corpus expands the next agent-reviewed work queue. It does not add non-agent labels, does not rerun the corpus study by itself, and must not be described as a passed 99% precision claim.
